verdict.rationale: Apple documents Continuity/Handoff features (docs-4, docs-21, docs-29) that let users start work on one device (e.g., Messages, Safari, calls) and continue on a paired Mac/iPhone/iPad, plus copy-paste, calls, and phone mirroring across devices. This directly matches the story of starting a task on one device and finishing on another. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of Handoff reliability and broader task types beyond Messages/browsing.
